query:
SELECT 
  s.id,
  s.player_name,
  s.final_score,
  s.outcome,
  s.converted_count,
  s.weeks_used,
  FROM_UNIXTIME(s.created_at / 1000) AS created_at_utc,
  COUNT(t.id) AS turn_count
FROM game_sessions s
LEFT JOIN game_turns t ON t.session_id = s.id
WHERE s.created_at < UNIX_TIMESTAMP('2026-05-14 00:00:00+08:00') * 1000
GROUP BY s.id
ORDER BY s.created_at DESC;
